data.content_ref: inline:After the skeptical fixpoint leaves some nodes suspended, run an advisory post-pass that ranks suspended nodes by defense depth: the number of distinct accepted defenders reachable via two attack steps (accepted -> attacker -> suspended). This never relabels a node, so determinism, polynomial cost, and reinstatement semantics are untouched — but it gives the loop a principled order for conjecture refinement and makes the suspended set's structure visible instead of a silent remainder. The grounded extension itself was never the problem; this targets what to do with its output.
